units.source_text: “实在没法子，是你们自己播下的种子……”

en.t: There is really no helping it; you sowed these seeds yourselves...

units.source_text: 他禁不住心急慌忙，快嘴快舌地说，

en.t: Unable to hold back, he blurted out in a frantic rush,
We deceived each other, so that should make us even now, shouldn't it?

units.source_text: 我可是人呐，不可能像狗那样能简单上一把锁……

en.t: I am a human being, you know; you cannot simply put a lock on me like a dog...

units.source_text: 谁见了，都会觉得我这是出色的正当防卫。”

en.t: Anyone who saw it would think this was a fine case of legitimate self-defense.
